subject: Observability vendor renewals — coordinated negotiation and retention plan
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@datadog.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Datadog renewal & bulk retention pricing

Hi Evelyn,

Following our QBR, I wanted to send over the refreshed renewal proposal for your account. I attached a PDF that shows tiered pricing for log retention add-ons (30/90/365 days), a recommended retention mix based on your current ingestion, and an uplift credit when you commit to a 12-month reserved volume.

Quick details:
- Current monthly ingest: ~18TB
- Suggested retention mix: 30d for hot logs, 90d for security streams, 365d for compliance snapshots
- Proposed annual commitment discount: 18% off list for a 12-month reserved commit

If you want, I can run a short ingest + retention simulation with our pricing engine and share expected monthly spend under each retention plan. Are you available for a 30-minute sync next week?

Attachments: [Datadog_Pricing_Proposal_Q4.pdf (PDF)]

Best,
Alex
Account Executive, Infrastructure
Datadog
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@datadog.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Jordan Patel <jordan.patel@observability-consulting.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Datadog renewal & bulk retention pricing

Alex — thanks for the proposal and the model. Quick household notes before we schedule:

1) We need a single line item for the security team's retention (SOC/IR) that is legally immutable for 12 months — this will be purchased through our Private offering; any changes require procurement sign-off.
2) Ops wants to avoid a large step in monthly cost; can you provide an amortized view that shows per-token equivalent pricing after the credit?
3) Procurement needs billing cadence options (monthly vs. annual) and any early-termination clauses called out.

Marcus — can you confirm what ingest lines are considered "security streams" vs "application logs" for the model? Monica — please loop in Finance to confirm the PO routing and preferred payment terms.

I'll do a consolidated vendor ask once I have Datadog numbers + Grafana and Sentry responses. Prefer a 30-min cross-vendor call on Oct 20 if everyone is available.

Thanks,
Evelyn
Director, Infrastructure Platforms
Redwood Inference
From: Grafana Sales <sales@grafana.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Grafana Cloud renewal options and retention add-ons

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for reaching out. I've attached our updated terms document (GrafanaCloud_Terms_v2.docx). A few notes:
- Grafana Cloud's long-term retention add-on is priced separately from logs; we offer a blended discount when bundling metrics + logs + traces.
- For customers with split vendor setups (e.g., Datadog for logs, Grafana for metrics/visualization), we offer a partnership credit that reduces dashboarding costs if you centralize dashboards on Grafana Cloud.
- We can carve out a read-only compliance archive export to a designated S3 bucket for audit purposes (monthly egress applies).

I'll hold a 30-minute slot on Oct 20 at 10:00 PT if you'd like to do a cross-vendor discussion (I can join with a product person).

Attachments: [GrafanaCloud_Terms_v2.docx]

Cheers,
Grafana Sales
From: Jordan Patel <jordan.patel@observability-consulting.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:58:00 -0700
Subject: Re: cross-vendor renewal sync — agenda and recommendation brief

Evelyn/Team,

Thanks for inviting Observability Consulting. Agenda for 20 Oct (proposed 30 minutes):
- 5m: current spend snapshot + retention mix (Marcus)
- 8m: vendor offers summary (Alex, Grafana)
- 10m: recommended path (Jordan) — hybrid retention with single-source-of-truth archive + reserved commit on primary vendor
- 5m: next steps & procurement action items

Pre-reads: I attached a one-page recommendation that maps to your compliance needs; we suggest a 12-month commit with a 6-month review window and a small consulting retainer for cutover automation.

Attachments: [Renewal_Recommendation_OnePager.pdf]

Jordan Patel
Principal Consultant
Observability Consulting
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@datadog.com>, Grafana Sales <sales@grafana.com>, Sentry Renewals <renewals@sentry.io>, Jordan Patel <jordan.patel@observability-consulting.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 22 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability vendor renewals — coordinated negotiation and retention plan

Hi all — thanks for joining the call earlier. Follow-up and procurement asks below: 

1) Datadog: Please provide the amortized monthly view per TB and a separate line for the security retention (immutable, billed annually). Also confirm the exact early-termination language for reserved commits.
2) Grafana: We need the S3 export SLA and an estimate of monthly egress costs for ~5TB/month of archive retrievals; please include the partnership credit math in the proposal.
3) Sentry: (cc'd) — can you confirm whether your retention add-on supports indexed search on archived events beyond 180 days and any associated costs?
4) Observability Consulting: please send a detailed statement of work for the recommended cutover automation and a fixed-price estimate for a 6-week engagement.

Procurement timeline: 
- Proposals due: Oct 29, 2026
- Internal review + legal: Nov 2–5, 2026
- Target sign: Nov 12, 2026

I've uploaded a tracker to the shared drive (see related links). If any vendor needs a contract redline window, flag now.

Attachments referenced: [Sentry_Retention_Addendum.pdf]

Thanks,
Monica Patel (on behalf of Procurement)
Senior Finance Manager — Vendor Ops
Redwood Inference
